Our Calm and Relaxing Kochi Break

We traveled from Chennai to Kochi, Kerala on Dec 10-13, 2026, just the three of us — my wife, our 9-year-old son and me. It fell right during our son's school vacation, and we were looking for a relaxing beach vacation with calm beaches to beat the Chennai heat without it being too cold, and something budget-friendly for our family of three.

We began with a happy selfie together in the airport departures hall. During the trip we saw a majestic tiered temple standing peacefully on a calm lake with lush mountains behind it, and we loved sitting together on the sand watching a glowing sunset over the ocean.

We also took a joyful selfie together in helmets in front of lush green rice terraces, and shared a joyful selfie together in front of a beautiful lush waterfall. We finished with a bright selfie together in our airplane seats, thankful for a calm and relaxing time together.
